conditions.L: Identical fixed statement and P66 shared files plus frozen NumStability library.
conditions.N: Identical fixed statement and P66 shared files; no NumStability artifact.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p66_t2_two_level_superblock_dot_error (fp : P66FPModel) (b : ℕ) ... : absolute error ≤ gamma_(2b−1) times sum of absolute input products
formal_statement.plain_language: The two-level superblock dot product obeys the paper’s gamma_(2b−1) forward error bound.

informal_proof: Apply the componentwise error bound to each sequential block dot product, apply recursive-sum backward error to block totals, compose their factors within γ_(2b−1), and bound the resulting perturbed sum.
informal_statement: For the t=2 equal-block superblock dot product, the absolute forward error is bounded by γ_(2b−1) times the sum of absolute input products.
